phase_schedule: all 24 source fits with up to four concurrent isolated processes
all 24 adaptations with up to four concurrent isolated processes after the source wave

resource_basis.reason: Four workers consume under 3 GiB of immutable cache payload before modest model/activation overhead on a 48 GiB A40; the model is small and each worker uses two CPU threads.

process_isolation.cache_access: read-only memory maps copied into each worker CUDA process
process_isolation.checkpoint_namespace: unique immutable job id plus unique attempt UUID
process_isolation.completion_namespace: one append-only completed JSON per immutable job id
process_isolation.overlap_protection: one coordinator OS lock and one OS lock per immutable job id
process_isolation.worker_stdout_stderr: separate files per immutable job within a unique controller-run directory
process_isolation.worker_completion_status: scientific completion and controller exit records use fsync plus append-only atomic rename

detachment.mechanism: PowerShell Start-Process without -Wait, hidden, with redirected stdout and stderr
